clock_regression_summary.warning: Context categories identify which rows carry time increases; they do not certify legitimate clock correction or erroneous live event ordering.

denominator_accounting.signatures: Qualifiers and descriptors are raw CSV strings, case preserved; missing represented as <missing>. Each count is an event/issue count, never a game count.

minimal_observed_goaltending_reproductio.note: Exact observed rows 327,329,330 only. The subset is deliberately partial and is not scored or made eligible. Demonstrates grouping behavior, not full-game ground truth.

primary_rule_background.purpose: Defensive award is scored and resumed as a made field goal; supports linking same-clock shot/violation records rather than treating both as new possessions.
Kicked-ball possession depends on offense/defense; jump-ball violation can award possession or repeat the toss.
FT lane outcomes depend on shooter/team/opponent, attempt result, and whether the attempt remains live.
Official timing review can add time, but archive row context alone cannot certify that this explains a given regression.

rule_background_limit: Retrieved 2026-11-02. Current official pages explain categories only; archived season-specific rule versions and independent footage adjudication remain required.
classification_limit: Aggregate adjacency is descriptive; only selected exact neighborhoods are manually interpreted. Goaltending adjacency is not a claim that all 2,540 cases share one cause or that any count is independently validated. No fixes applied.
baseline_version_note: All existing triage counts and parser line references describe canonical_candidate_v1 at the frozen parser SHA, not the current production parser.
